title: The Tamayori's Fate
overview: Tamaki enjoy the time of peace after the Onikirimaru incident and recap her memories from first season.

title: Ominous Dark Cloud
overview: Takuma starts to feel effect of Onikirimaru's presence.

title: The Traitor's Vow
overview: After Suguru defected, Tamaki and the other guardians try to cope with what happened. Shinji goes see Aria again, while Ryou takes things into his own hands. Ashiya starts to become more involved.

title: The Destruction of the Five Houses
overview: After escaping Logos, the guardians are not in their best mood. The mountain god reveals more light to Onikirimaru... and Takuma's condition. Drei grows impatience and asks Suguru to lead him the next Artifact.

title: The Truth of Tears
overview: Suguru fights with Mahiro and Yuuichi. Takuma is let go and Tamaki is put on house arrest. Shinji learns a secret from Tamaki's grandmother that changes the way he feels for Mitsuru.

title: The Deceitful Heart
overview: Aria converses with Suguru about the Artifacts, while Takuma and Tamaki comes to terms with their situation.

title: Memory of a Dream
overview: Tamaki learns the truth about Onikirimaru and the Tamayori Princess's fate.

title: Their Resolution
overview: Tamaki and Takuma makes a run from the shine. Eins's past is revealed.

title: The Eternal Promise
overview: Kiyono and Ryou reveals more truth to Tamaki and Takuma. The Guardians reevalute their situation while Drei decides the move on his own.

title: The Power of the Gods
overview: Eins reveals the true reasons of why he is protecting Aria.

title: Scarlet Fragments
overview: Takuma is willing sacrifice his life for Tamaki's. However, a deceit lies around the corner.

title: The Guardians' Awakening
overview: Takuma is in control of his power. The Guardians retrieved the Artifacts thanks to Aria. With the truth and lies out of the way, there is one thing left to do....

title: The Eternal Pledge
overview: Drei has Onikirimaru and brings forth hell on Earth. Both guardians and former enemies must prevent the end of the world.
